experiences.name: Djemaa el-Fna Square at Dusk
experiences.description: Experience the legendary main square of Marrakech as it transforms at sunset into a spectacular open-air theatre. Watch snake charmers, storytellers, acrobats, and musicians perform while sampling street food from dozens of stalls offering harira soup, grilled meats, and fresh orange juice. This is the beating heart of Marrakech's cultural life and a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

experiences.name: Sahara Desert Camel Trek and Overnight Camp
experiences.description: Ride a camel into the golden Erg Chebbi dunes near Merzouga at sunset, arriving at a traditional Berber desert camp. Spend the night under an extraordinary canopy of stars, enjoy a tagine dinner cooked over an open fire, and listen to Gnawa musicians play around the campfire. Wake before dawn to witness a breathtaking Sahara sunrise from the top of a dune.

experiences.name: Medina Souks and Tanneries Walking Tour
experiences.description: Navigate the labyrinthine medieval souks of Marrakech's ancient medina with a local guide, exploring spice markets, leather workshops, and artisan quarters. Visit the famous Chouara-style tanneries from a rooftop vantage point to witness the centuries-old leather dyeing process using natural pigments. Bargain for saffron, argan oil, and handwoven textiles directly from craftsmen.
experiences.location: Souk Semmarine and Tanneries Quarter, Medina, Marrakech

experiences.name: Traditional Moroccan Cooking Class
experiences.description: Join a local Marrakchi family or small cooking school for a hands-on half-day class beginning with a guided tour of the spice souk to select fresh ingredients. Learn to prepare authentic dishes including chicken bastilla, lamb tagine with preserved lemons and olives, and honey-drenched chebakia pastries. Sit down together to enjoy the full meal with mint tea in a traditional riad setting.

experiences.name: Aït Benhaddou Kasbah Exploration
experiences.description: Visit the UNESCO World Heritage ksar of Aït Benhaddou, one of the most spectacular and best-preserved fortified Berber villages in Morocco, rising dramatically from the banks of the Ounila River. Climb through the ancient earthen towers and granaries that have served as a backdrop for films like Gladiator and Game of Thrones. A local guide will share the history of the trans-Saharan trade routes that made this kasbah a vital stop for centuries.
experiences.location: Aït Benhaddou, Ouarzazate Province, Southern Morocco
